questions.q: India's services sector growth in July hit a slowdown not seen since when?
questions.explain: The news explicitly states services expanded at its slowest pace in 53 months during July.

questions.q: What new requirement has India imposed on foreign-backed ecommerce firms?
options: They must maintain minimum inventory levels in warehouses
They must register as exporters and stock goods only against confirmed export orders
They must pay higher import duties on foreign goods
They must establish joint ventures with Indian companies
questions.explain: India's government mandates foreign-invested ecommerce companies register as exporters and only stock goods against confirmed export orders, not speculation.

questions.q: What is the RBI's new economic growth forecast for next year?
questions.explain: The RBI raised its economic growth forecast to 6.7% and kept borrowing costs at 5.25%.

questions.q: How much venture capital funding did MagicSchool AI secure?
questions.explain: Adeel Khan, founder of MagicSchool AI, secured $63 million in venture capital funding for his edtech platform.

questions.q: How many luxury resorts are Bhartiya Hospitality and Oberoi Group planning to build by 2030?
questions.explain: Bhartiya Hospitality and EIH (Oberoi Group) are partnering to build and operate 20 ultra-luxury resorts across India and internationally by 2030.
